event.description: Reduce each feed-forward hidden width from 48 to 44 while retaining learned positions and all other baseline mechanisms.
event.proposal: Family: feed-forward width. Retained incumbent is 6080 parameters at 100.000000%, a +1.000000 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family history: no prior accepted or failed result; 0 prior attempts. The distinct position-representation attempt failed as an optimization failure (0% validation throughout 30000 steps, no checkpoint), so it does not establish a feed-forward capacity boundary. Hypothesis: a 44-wide GELU bottleneck retains sufficient carry and digit-processing capacity while saving 256 parameters, from 6080 to 5824. This is a parameterization-preserving compression, not a representational change. It is more informative than the nearest untested alternative, a larger width reduction to 40, because it locates the first compression boundary with the smallest coherent decrement.
